verses.text: Haxo Jehová ix chekankot winhaj Natán t'a winhaj David chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan jun ab'ix tik winh t'a winh: --Ha t'a jun chonhab', ay chawanh heb' winh winak: Ay jun winh te b'eyum, ay pax junxo winh te meb'a'.
Ha winh b'eyum chi', te ay nok' skalnel winh yet' nok' swakax.

Haxo pax winh meb'a' chi' jun, junnhej pitanh tzun skalnel winh manb'il yuj. A' winh ix q'uib'tzitan nok'. Ha t'a yol spat winh ix q'uib' nok' yet' heb' yuninal. Ha tas swa winh, tas yuk' winh, a chi' swa nok', syuk' nok'. Schelway nok' winh, te xajan nok' yuj winh. Ichato yisil nok' winh.

Ay jun k'u, ay jun winh tonhej sb'eyeq'ui, ix ek' winh yak' spaxyal winh b'eyum chi'. Ha winh b'eyum chi', maj syamlaj junok nok' skalnel winh, ma junok nok' swakax winh yik syak'an schi winh paxyalwum chi', te ya yel nok' yuj winh. Haxo jun pitanh nok' yik winh meb'a' chi' ix b'at yak' ik'jokkot winh. Ha nok' ix yak' winh schi jun winh paxyalwum chi', xchi winhaj Natán chi' t'a winhaj rey David chi'.
Ix kot wal yowal winhaj rey David chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Natán chi': --T'a yichanh Jehová Dios swala', a jun winh icha chi' ix sk'ulej, smoj wal scham winh.
Yowalil syak' chanhwanhok nok' winh sk'exulok nok' yune' kalnel chi', yujto a jun winh winak chi' malaj wal jab'ok yok'elk'olal winh t'a yetanimail, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Natán chi': --Ha jun winh chi', a ach toni. Icha tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik t'ayach: Ha in ix ach in sik'och sreyalok Israel, ix ach in kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Saúl.
Ix wak' spat yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh ajalil chi' t'ayach, ix ach wak'anoch sreyalok chonhab' Israel yet' Judá. Tato jab'nhej juntzanh chi' tzab'i, tzato yal wak'an nanhalokxo t'ayach.
¿Tas yuj ix a patikejel in cheknab'il, ix a k'ulej tas to max scha in k'ool? Ix a milcham winhaj Urías heteo yet' k'een yespada heb' amonita. Ix ik'ankan ix yetb'eyum winh chi'.
Yuj chi' aynhej mach ol miljokcham t'a skal inhtilal, yujto ix in a patikejeli, ix ik'ankan ix yetb'eyum winhaj Urías heteo.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Ol wak'och yaelal t'a ib'anh. Ha yaelal chi', ha t'a skal heb' uninal ol elta, t'a wal ichanh ol wik'elta heb' ix etb'eyum, ol wak'an heb' ix t'a junok winh uninal, ol way winh yet' heb' ix t'a k'ualil t'a yichanh anima.
Ha ach tik, elk'altak ix a k'ulej, a inxo tik, t'a wal sakil k'inal t'a k'ualil ol in ch'oxel t'a yichanh chonhab' Israel, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Natán chi'.

Ix schaan smulok winhaj rey David t'a yichanh winhaj Natán chi', ix yalan winh: --T'a wal yel, ix och in mul t'a Jehová, xchi winh. Ix yalanpax winhaj Natán chi': --Yel ton tzala', palta ix ak'ji lajwok a mul chi' yuj Jehová, yuj chi' manhxo ol ach chamlaj.
Palta a yuj tas ix a k'ulej chi', tz'alji chukal lolonel t'a Jehová yuj heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ay, yuj chi' ol cham jun uninal toto ix alji chi', xchi winhaj Natán chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix pax winhaj Natán chi' t'a spat. Haxo Jehová, ix ak'anoch syaelal jun yuninal winhaj David chi' yet' ix yetb'eyumkan winhaj Urías chi'.
Yuj chi', ix och ijan winh sk'anan t'a Jehová to sb'oxi sk'ol winh unin chi'. Ix och winh t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix kannhej telan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a junjun ak'wal.
Ha jantak heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' smunlaj yet' winh, tz'och ijan heb' winh stewi to sk'e waan winh t'a sat lum chi', palta maxtzak yal-laj sk'ol winh, max b'at walaj winh yet' heb' winh.

Haxo t'a yukil k'ual syamchaj winh unin chi' yuj ilya chi', ix chami. Ix te xiw heb' winh smunlajum winh rey chi' yalan t'ay, yujto sna heb': Ina ayik pitzanto winh unin chi', maj scha yab' winh tas ix kala', okxom wal tiknaik. Tato skal t'a winh to toxo ix chami, tas am ol sk'ulok winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yab'an winhaj rey David chi' ayik sajson heb' winh sloloni, ix snaanel winh to toxo ix cham winh unin chi', yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Tom toxo ix chami? xchi winh. --Toxo ix cham mamin rey, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winh icha chi', ix k'e waan winh t'a sat lu'um chi', ix sb'ikanel sb'a winh, ix yak'ank'e yanhal xil sjolom winh, ix sk'exanel spichul winh, ix och winh ejmelal t'a yol skajnub' Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at sk'anan wa sb'a winh t'a yol spat.

Ix sk'anb'an heb' winh smunlajwum winh chi' t'ay: --Mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj icha tik tza k'ulej? Ayik pitzanto jun uninal chi', manh jab'ok syal a k'ol tzach wa'i, tzach ok' yuj. Haxo tiknaik toxo ix chami, tzach k'e waan, tzach wa'i, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh: --Ayik pitzanto winh unin chi', tzin och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, tzin oq'ui, a in naani talaj tzato ok' sk'ol Jehová t'ayin.
Haxo pax tiknaik, ¿tasto wal yuj tzin och t'a tzek'ojk'olal? ¿Tom olto pitzwok winh? Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol jax winh t'ayin, anhej to a in ol in b'at b'aj ix k'och winh chi', xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an sniwanil sk'ol ix Betsabé winhaj David chi', ix way winh yet' ix, ix skuchanoch yune' ix. Ix alji junxo yune' ix, Salomón ix yak' ix b'iej. Te xajan ix aj jun unin chi' yuj Jehová.
Ix schekanb'at winhaj Natán Jehová yal t'a winhaj rey David chi' to xajan jun unin chi' yuj. Yuj chi' Jedidías ix sb'iej jun unin chi' yuj Jehová.
Yakb'an chi', a winhaj Joab ix ak'an owal yet' heb' amonita t'a Rabá. Ayik wanxo yak'an ganar winh yoch t'a yol jun chonhab' chi',
ix yalankot winh t'a winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: Wanxo woch t'a yol chonhab' Rabá. Ha jun cuartel b'aj ay heb' stanhwan ha ha' sk'anchaj t'a chonhab' tik, ayxo och t'a yol in k'ab'.

Yuj chi', mamin rey, molb'ej masanil heb' soldado aykan het'ok, tzach kot yet' heb' ak' owal t'a jun chonhab' tik yik tzak'an ganar. Q'uinalok a in swak' ganar jun chonhab' tik, a in am tzin b'inajkan t'ay, xchikot winhaj Joab chi'.
Ix smolb'an masanil heb' soldado winh rey chi', ix b'at winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Rabá chi'. Ix yak'an ganar winh yik'ankani.

Ix yik'anek' scorona winh sreyal heb' amonita chi' winh. Ix yak'ank'e heb' t'a sjolom winh. Ay jun k'een k'een te karo stojol ayoch t'ay. Ha jun corona chi', te al, ay am oxeok arroba yalil. Tzijtumto pax tastak te ay stojol ix yik'ek' winhaj David chi' t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Haxo heb' anima ixto kani, ix ik'jielta heb' yuj winh, ix ak'jioch heb' t'a munlajel ya, icha t'a k'een sierra, k'een piocha yet' pax k'een ch'akab'. Ix ak'jipaxoch heb' t'a mukoj ladrillo t'a horno. Hanheja' icha pax chi' ix aj masanil heb' ay t'a juntzanhxo schonhab' heb' amonita yuj winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj winh yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.
